title: TimeThink: Eliciting Compositional Reasoning in Timeseries Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Timeseries multimodal large language models (TS-MLLMs) have recently begun leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for question-answering tasks. However, these models often fail to capture dynamic temporal patterns, providing only implicit reasoning that lacks the underlying explanations critical for high-stakes applications like healthcare. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based timeseries language models aim to address this, they often fall short because they are trained on narrow, in-distribution data and struggle with out-of-distribution compositional questions. translated_title: TimeThink：在时间序列大语言模型中引出组合式推理
translated_abstract: 时间序列多模态大语言模型（TS-MLLM）近来开始利用大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力来执行问答任务。然而，这些模型往往无法捕捉动态的时间模式，只能提供隐式推理，缺乏对医疗等高风险应用至关重要的底层解释。虽然基于强化学习（RL）的时间序列语言模型旨在解决这一问题，但由于它们是在狭窄的分布内数据上训练的，在面对分布外的组合式问题时往往表现不佳。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TimeThink，一个用于引出组合式时间序列推理的合成框架。核心时间序列基元（如趋势、季节性）是与领域无关的，并且可以被确定性地生成。基于这一前提，TimeThink首先设计了一个合成数据生成器，用于生成原子和组合式的……（摘要不完整，在此处截断）
tldr: TimeThink利用与领域无关的时间序列基元（如趋势、季节性）设计合成数据生成框架，通过原子和组合式合成数据来引出时间序列大语言模型的组合式时间序列推理能力。
en_tdlr: TimeThink presents a synthetic data generation framework leveraging domain-independent timeseries primitives (e.g., trend, seasonality) to elicit compositional timeseries reasoning in TS-MLLMs through atomic and compositional synthetic training data.
